info.description:
AI-assisted market intelligence and paper-trading execution platform.

Every AI-backed endpoint degrades safely: with no model key configured the quantitative readings still return and responses are flagged `degraded`. Outputs are research signals, not investment advice.
info.title: AI Finance Intelligence

schema.title: Response List Alerts Api Alerts Get

post.description:
Historical simulation: metrics summary + equity curve for the symbol.

The run is saved and the report comes back carrying its ``id``, so a result
worth revisiting does not have to be re-simulated to be seen again.

get.description: Saved runs, newest first, without the equity curve.
Several runs side by side, plus the leader on each metric.
One stored run in full, curve and trades included.
Ranked, categorized events (legal/macro/tech/executive) with impact scores.
Typed JSON contracts so the UI can bind to a single source of truth.
Current net positions reconstructed from the ledger.
N x N return-correlation matrix across the user's active holdings.

The FULL ledger as CSV, for tax filing and audit.

Deliberately unpaginated: a partial export is worse than none for the
purpose, and this is a download rather than a UI read. Cells are escaped
against spreadsheet formula injection on the way out.
Markowitz max-Sharpe target weights vs. the current allocation.

Equity curve, return, and max drawdown from the daily equity snapshots.

Snapshots are captured lazily (once per active UTC day), so the series can
have gaps; `sparse` flags that, and the gaps are left unobserved rather
than interpolated flat.
Instant quant risk + realized/unrealized P&L from the ledger.

A page of the ledger, oldest first.

Bounded by default so one account's history can never be an unbounded
query. `X-Total-Count` carries the full size, so a client can tell a
complete answer from a truncated one without the response shape changing.

get.description:
The append-only compliance trail: every signal that became an order.

Scoped to the caller — the audit log is per-user and there is no operator
view here, so no user can ever read another's reasoning or positions.

post.description: Store broker API keys ENCRYPTED at rest. Secrets are never returned.

get.description: One unified, typed payload for the trading UI.

post.description: Validate the user's risk limits, then place a paper order from an AI signal.

get.description:
The full compliance trail as CSV.

Carries the model's reasoning verbatim, which is exactly the untrusted
free text that makes formula escaping non-optional here.

post.description:
Operator toggle: manually halt (enabled=True) or resume automated trading.

Halting also flattens working orders unless ``cancel_open`` is false. The
halt is written FIRST so no new order can slip in behind the cancellations,
and the flatten is best-effort: a venue that refuses one cancel must not
leave the switch un-pulled.

get.description:
A page of submitted orders and their reconciliation state.

`X-Total-Count` reports the full size so truncation is detectable.

schema.title: Response List Orders Api Trade Orders Get

delete.description:
Request cancellation of one working order.

Returns the order in ``pending_cancel``: the venue has accepted the request,
but the order is not dead until reconciliation says so. 409 when the order
already reached a terminal state, 404 when it is not this user's.

get.description: One submitted order and its reconciliation state.

patch.description:
Amend a working order's size or limit price, keeping its queue position.

The venue retires the original and issues a replacement, so the RESPONSE IS
THE NEW ORDER, with a new id. 409 when the order is past amending, 423 when
the kill-switch is engaged.

get.description: On-demand broker-vs-ledger position drift for the current user.

post.description: Set the daily-loss kill-switch threshold (percent; 0 disables).

get.description:
Did following the AI signals actually make money?

Marks every filled signal against the latest quote and reports the hit rate
by confidence bucket, so `min_trade_confidence` can be judged on evidence
rather than taste. Unrealized by construction — see `basis` on the payload.

post.description:
Ingest an Alpaca trade-update and reconcile fills into the ledger instantly.

Shared-secret authenticated (constant-time compare). This is the fast path;
the background poll loop remains a backstop and is idempotent with it. An
unknown order id is accepted but writes nothing (never raises).

get.description: Liveness. Unchanged shape: this is the long-standing public probe.
Explicit alias for /health, for orchestrators that want the pair named.

Readiness. 503 when a required dependency is unreachable.

The full report is returned on both paths - an operator reading a failing
probe needs to know WHICH dependency went, and a 503 with an empty body
makes them go find out from somewhere else.

frames.end: Stream complete; carries citations and the disclaimer.
frames.error: Recoverable stream error; the socket stays open.
frames.event: Market-wide event intelligence broadcast to every socket.
frames.token: Incremental text chunk of the model's rationale.
